children: U.S. LNG infrastructure firm's Q3 revenue fell and missed analyst expectations
Adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company says higher earnings driven by new Jordan charter and improved LNG margins
Company narrows 2026 adj EBITDA outlook to $495 mln-$515 mln
Company sees 2026 maintenance capex at $65 mln-$75 mln, down on deferred activities
Company raises 2026 growth capex guidance to $400 mln-$410 mln on FSRU conversion timing
JORDAN CHARTER - Co said new charter in Jordan contributed to higher net income and adjusted EBITDA
DELIVERY TIMING - Co said timing of deliveries under Atlantic Basin agreement partially offset earnings growth
COMMERCIAL AGREEMENTS - Co said new and extended long-term agreements expanded contracted earnings base
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 10 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the natural gas utilities peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Excelerate Energy, Inc. is $43.00, about 22.4% above its November 3 closing price of $35.13
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 23 three months ago
